overview: The Medford School Committee held a public hearing on the recommended fiscal year 2027 operating budget. The committee approved the preliminary budget proposal, which includes a $4.1 million base budget increase, while prioritizing the reinstatement of a vacant inclusion specialist position if funding allows.

items.title: Opening of Public Hearing
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn opened the public hearing on the superintendent's recommended fiscal year 2027 operating budget.

items.title: FY27 Preliminary Budget Presentation, Discussion, and Vote
items.summary: The finance team presented a revised FY27 budget proposal detailing $3.3 million in net reductions, and the committee voted to approve the budget recommendations while prioritizing the reinstatement of a vacant inclusion specialist.

subject: FY 2027 School Operating Budget Public Hearing
